item.title: oliroe created DIYgod/RSSHub: Issue #8116
item.description:
What feature is it?

Currently there's a feed for new issues on a particular repository but there isn't a feed for comments on an individual issue.

What problem does this feature solve?

I would like to be updated whenever there's a new comment on an issue i am following

Additional description

As an example I would like to be able to follow any changes to this issue user-DIYgod, repository-RSSHub, issue-8116
